case_number: Criminal Appeal Nos. 1109-1110 of 2010; Crl. A. No. 1229/2011, Crl. A. No. 1230/2011, Crl. A. No. 213/2012 & Crl. A. No. 682/2013
summary: Sole eye-witness testimony sufficiency for murder conviction; multiple stab injuries causing death; prior land dispute as motive; concurrent findings by lower courts upheld; hostility of witnesses does not discard testimony if corroborated by other evidence; standard: beyond reasonable doubt; credibility of PW-1 confirmed through corroboration and consistency; presence of accused on spot undisputed; appeal dismissed affirming life sentence for murder.
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; conviction and life imprisonment under Section 302 IPC upheld against all accused including Ravasaheb @ Ravasahebgouda (A-6), Yankappa Shivappa Naik (A-7) and Parappa @ Gulappa (A-8).
